name: Access Request for Other
description: Notify requested-for identity that the access request has been submitted.
subject: ${requesterName} has submitted an access request on your behalf.
body:
Access Request Notification

Hello ${user.name},

${requesterName} has requested the following access on your behalf:

#foreach ( $type in ${requestedObjectDetailsByType.keySet()} )

$type :

    #foreach ( $detail in ${requestedObjectDetailsByType.get($type)} )
  • ${detail.name} #if($detail.startDate) (Start Date: ${detail.startDate}) #end#if($detail.removeDate) (End Date: ${detail.removeDate}) #end
    • #end
#end

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
